Name: cxl-fmd CXL Health Message Registry
Description: This registry defines the messages cxl-fmd puts in Status.Conditions for what a CXL memory device reports in Get Health Info (4200h, CXL r4.0 Table 8-315): each Health Status bit, each Media Status that is not Normal or Not Ready, and Additional Status Bit[4] and Bit[5].  The messages of Health Status and Media Status are the descriptions Table 8-315 gives; those of Additional Status are its "The device's count of total corrected errors has risen to or above the user-programmable ... threshold" with volatile or persistent added (cxl-fmd's wording), and MediaStatusReserved and the Resolutions are cxl-fmd's.

MaintenanceNeeded.Description: Indicates that Health Status Bit[0], Maintenance Needed, is set (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
MaintenanceNeeded.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Bit[0], Maintenance Needed, of the Health Status field of Get Health Info.

PerformanceDegraded.Description: Indicates that Health Status Bit[1], Performance Degraded, is set (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
PerformanceDegraded.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Bit[1], Performance Degraded, of the Health Status field of Get Health Info.
PerformanceDegraded.Message: The device is no longer operating at optimal performance.

HardwareReplacementNeeded.Description: Indicates that Health Status Bit[2], Hardware Replacement Needed, is set (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
HardwareReplacementNeeded.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Bit[2], Hardware Replacement Needed, of the Health Status field of Get Health Info.
HardwareReplacementNeeded.Message: The device should immediately be replaced.

MemoryCapacityDegraded.Description: Indicates that Health Status Bit[3], Memory Capacity Degraded, is set (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
MemoryCapacityDegraded.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Bit[3], Memory Capacity Degraded, of the Health Status field of Get Health Info.
MemoryCapacityDegraded.Message: The device is no longer operating at the expected memory capacity.

WritePersistencyLost.Description: Indicates that the Media Status is 02h, Write persistency Lost (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
WritePersistencyLost.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Media Status 02h in Get Health Info.
WritePersistencyLost.Message: The device cannot persist write requests but is able to read stored data.

AllDataLost.Description: Indicates that the Media Status is 03h, All data lost (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
AllDataLost.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Media Status 03h in Get Health Info.
AllDataLost.Message: All data has been lost from the device.

WritePersistencyLossOnPowerLoss.Description: Indicates that the Media Status is 04h, Write Persistency Loss in the Event of Power Loss (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
WritePersistencyLossOnPowerLoss.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Media Status 04h in Get Health Info.
WritePersistencyLossOnPowerLoss.Message: The device's ability to persist subsequent write requests may be lost in the event of a power loss.

WritePersistencyLossOnShutdown.Description: Indicates that the Media Status is 05h, Write Persistency Loss in Event of Shutdown (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
WritePersistencyLossOnShutdown.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Media Status 05h in Get Health Info.
WritePersistencyLossOnShutdown.Message: The device's ability to persist subsequent write requests may be lost when the device is shut down.

WritePersistencyLossImminent.Description: Indicates that the Media Status is 06h, Write Persistency Loss Imminent (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
WritePersistencyLossImminent.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Media Status 06h in Get Health Info.
WritePersistencyLossImminent.Message: The device's ability to persist subsequent write requests may be lost.

AllDataLossOnPowerLoss.Description: Indicates that the Media Status is 07h, All Data Loss in the Event of Power Loss (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
AllDataLossOnPowerLoss.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Media Status 07h in Get Health Info.
AllDataLossOnPowerLoss.Message: All data on the device may be lost in the event of a power loss.

AllDataLossOnShutdown.Description: Indicates that the Media Status is 08h, All Data Loss in the Event of Shutdown (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
AllDataLossOnShutdown.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Media Status 08h in Get Health Info.
AllDataLossOnShutdown.Message: All data on the device may be lost when the device is shut down.

AllDataLossImminent.Description: Indicates that the Media Status is 09h, All Data Loss Imminent (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
AllDataLossImminent.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Media Status 09h in Get Health Info.
AllDataLossImminent.Message: All data on the device may be lost.

MediaStatusReserved.Description: Indicates that the device reported a Media Status that CXL r4.0 Table 8-315 reserves ("All other encodings are reserved").
MediaStatusReserved.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported, in Get Health Info, a Media Status that is not one of 00h to 09h.
MediaStatusReserved.Message: The device reported the reserved Media Status %1.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the Media Status the device reported, as two hexadecimal digits followed by h, such as 0Ah.

CorrectedVolatileErrorCount.Description: Indicates that Additional Status Bit[4], Corrected Volatile Error Count, is set (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
CorrectedVolatileErrorCount.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Bit[4], Corrected Volatile Error Count, of the Additional Status field of Get Health Info set to 1, Warning or Failure.
CorrectedVolatileErrorCount.Message: The device's count of total corrected volatile errors has risen to or above the user-programmable Warning or Failure threshold.

CorrectedPersistentErrorCount.Description: Indicates that Additional Status Bit[5], Corrected Persistent Error Count, is set (CXL r4.0 Table 8-315).
CorrectedPersistentErrorCount.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the device reported Bit[5], Corrected Persistent Error Count, of the Additional Status field of Get Health Info set to 1, Warning.
CorrectedPersistentErrorCount.Message: The device's count of total corrected persistent errors has risen to or above the user-programmable warning threshold.
